start.title: Они возвращаются
start.text:
Внизу стоят одиннадцать братьев.
Среди них Вениамин. Твое сердце пылает.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Order the steward to greet them
[TODO:ru] Strike them down for old wrongs

strike_consequence.title: Удержи Свою Руку
strike_consequence.text:
Бог не возвысил тебя, чтобы ты сокрушил их.
Есть высшая цель.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Order the steward to greet them

hide_consequence.title: Теперь не спрятаться
hide_consequence.text:
Отцу нужны его сыновья дома с зерном.
Ты должен действовать осторожно.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Order the steward to greet them

greet.title: Приведи Их
greet.text:
«Приведите этих людей в мой дом.
Приготовьте пир к полудню».

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Have them led to your home

demand_silver_consequence.title: Милость Прежде Всего
demand_silver_consequence.text:
Они боятся возвращенного серебра.
Успокой их нежно.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Have them led to your home

summon_meal.title: У Твоего Порога
summon_meal.text:
Они дрожат у твоего порога.
«Это из-за серебра», — шепчут они.

fear_consequence.title: Успокой Их Сердца
fear_consequence.text:
Страх закрывает сердца. Тебе нужны открытые.
Говори мир через управляющего.

weep1.title: Первый Взгляд на Вениамина
weep1.text:
Ты видишь сына своей матери.
Поток поднимается в твоей груди.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You hide your tears in your chamber.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Embrace him in front of all
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Not yet. The test is not done.

embrace_too_soon_consequence.title: Слишком Рано
embrace_too_soon_consequence.text:
Их сердца еще не испытаны.
Удалиться и плакать в одиночестве.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step away just in time.

recover.title: Умой Свое Лицо
recover.text:
Ты возвращаешься собранным.
Трапеза накрыта, братья сидят по возрасту.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Sit with them and break bread
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Benjamin's portion is five times more.

aloof_consequence.title: Почти Стол
aloof_consequence.text:
Совместная трапеза открывает сердца.
Сядь и благослови их хлеб.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Sit with them and break bread

dine.title: Странное Чудо
dine.text:
Они удивляются, что сидят по порядку рождения.
Тарелка Вениамина наполнена больше всех.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You must know their hearts toward Benjamin.
[TODO:ru] First test their love for Benjamin.

send_home_consequence.title: Остается Одно Испытание
send_home_consequence.text:
Оставят ли они Вениамина, как они
оставили тебя? Ты должен знать.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You call the steward in secret.

cup_plan.title: Серебряная Чаша
cup_plan.text:
«Спрячь мою чашу в мешке Вениамина.
Верни им и их серебро».

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Place the cup in his sack

cancel_consequence.title: Доведи До Конца
cancel_consequence.text:
Без этого испытания ты никогда не узнаешь.
Бог приготовил этот момент.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Place the cup in his sack

wrong_sack_consequence.title: Вениамин Один
wrong_sack_consequence.text:
Только опасность Вениамина покажет,
изменились ли они.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Place the cup in Benjamin's sack

send_off2.title: Рассветный Отъезд
send_off2.text:
Ослы нагружены, они отправляются на рассвете,
легкие на подъем.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send the steward to overtake them
[TODO:ru] Let them ride home in peace

let_go_consequence.title: Заверши Испытание
let_go_consequence.text:
Если они уйдут сейчас, ты ничего не узнаешь.
Немедленно пошли управляющего.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send the steward to overtake them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] He rides hard and catches them.

overtake.title: Остановлены на Дороге
overtake.text:
«Зачем вы отплатили злом за добро?
Где серебряная чаша моего господина?»

accuse_one_consequence.title: Ищи Все Справедливо
accuse_one_consequence.text:
Несправедливое обвинение разрушит испытание.
Пусть чаша говорит сама за себя.

search_sacks.title: [TODO:ru] Eldest to Youngest
search_sacks.text:
[TODO:ru] Sack after sack — clean, clean, clean.
Benjamin's is opened last.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The cup gleams in the grain.

stop_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Let It Surface
stop_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Stopping now buries the truth.
God is at work in this moment.

found_in_benjamin.title: [TODO:ru] The Cup Found
found_in_benjamin.text:
[TODO:ru] Silver glints in Benjamin's sack.
The brothers tear their robes.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bring all eleven back to you

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Will they all stand for him?

take_one_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Bring Them All
take_one_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] You must see if they stand by Benjamin.
Let them all return.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bring all eleven back to you

return_to_palace.title: [TODO:ru] Back Before You
return_to_palace.text:
[TODO:ru] Eleven men fall to the ground.
Dust on their faces, hearts broken.

no_test_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Wait for Judah
no_test_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Their words now will reveal everything.
Let them speak.

fall_down.title: [TODO:ru] On Their Knees
fall_down.text:
[TODO:ru] "God has uncovered our guilt," they cry.
"We are all your servants."

all_prison_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Only Benjamin
all_prison_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The test must isolate Benjamin alone.
Will the others abandon him?

death_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Never
death_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Benjamin is your blood. The test is
for the brothers, not for him.

judah_steps.title: [TODO:ru] Judah Steps Forward
judah_steps.text:
[TODO:ru] Judah lifts his head from the dust.
"My lord, hear your servant speak."

silence_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hear Him
silence_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Judah's words are the test's true answer.
Let him speak.

plea.title: [TODO:ru] "Take Me Instead"
plea.text:
[TODO:ru] "My father's life is bound to the boy.
Let me stay. Let Benjamin go home."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send all attendants out at once
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You can hold back no longer.
[TODO:ru] His pledge is the test's answer.
[TODO:ru] The time has come to reveal.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] He Has Changed
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Judah, who once sold you, now offers
himself for his brother. Reveal yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send all attendants out at once

accept_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] No More Hiding
accept_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The test is finished. Their hearts
are proven. It is time.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send all attendants out at once

send_attendants_out.title: [TODO:ru] "Go Out from Me!"
send_attendants_out.text:
[TODO:ru] The hall empties of Egyptians.
Only eleven brothers remain.

frighten_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Enough
frighten_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The waiting is finished. Speak.
Let love break the silence.

reveal.title: [TODO:ru] "I Am Joseph"
reveal.text:
[TODO:ru] "I am Joseph your brother.
Is my father still alive?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Not one of them can answer.

roar_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Gentleness
roar_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] They are terrified. This is not
the moment for triumph.

brothers_silent.title: [TODO:ru] Stunned to Silence
brothers_silent.text:
[TODO:ru] They cannot speak. They cannot move.
Terror and shame fill their eyes.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "Come near to me, I beg you."

demand_confess_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Comfort First
demand_confess_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Forgiveness is given before it is asked.
Draw them close.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "Come near to me, I beg you."

comfort.title: [TODO:ru] "Do Not Be Grieved"
comfort.text:
[TODO:ru] "I am Joseph, whom you sold.
Do not be angry with yourselves."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] "You will pay for what you did"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] God has turned it to good.

condemn_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] God's Hand
condemn_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] It was God's plan, not their cruelty,
that brought you here. Tell them.

it_was_god.title: [TODO:ru] To Save Many Lives
it_was_god.text:
[TODO:ru] "To preserve a remnant for you,
to save many lives — God did this."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You fall on his neck weeping.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Embrace
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Forgiveness without embrace is empty.
Go to Benjamin first.

kiss_benjamin.title: [TODO:ru] Brother on Brother
kiss_benjamin.text:
[TODO:ru] Benjamin weeps on your neck.
Then you kiss every brother and weep.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Tell them to bring Father here

hide_jacob_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Tell Father
hide_jacob_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Jacob has mourned you for years.
Do not steal one more day from him.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Tell them to bring Father here
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You give them wagons and gifts.

send_for_jacob.title: [TODO:ru] Wagons for the Journey
send_for_jacob.text:
[TODO:ru] Pharaoh hears and rejoices.
"Give them the best of all Egypt."

guards_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Trust Restored
guards_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Mistrust now wounds the new bond.
Let them go in peace.

jacob_hears.title: [TODO:ru] In Canaan
jacob_hears.text:
[TODO:ru] "Joseph is alive — and ruler of Egypt!"
Jacob's heart faints — then revives.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] "I will go and see him before I die."

abandon_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Together Again
abandon_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Father must see his son.
Take him with you to Egypt.

journey_egypt.title: [TODO:ru] Toward Goshen
journey_egypt.text:
[TODO:ru] Wagons cross the desert.
Father is coming. The family is whole.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Ride out to meet him in Goshen
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You fall on his neck a long time.

servants_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Go Yourself
servants_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] After all these years — go to him
with your own arms open.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Ride out to meet him in Goshen

ending.title: [TODO:ru] Father and Son
ending.text:
[TODO:ru] Jacob holds you. "Now I can die,
for I have seen your face again."
